purpose: Independently determine whether the two formally unqualified full-potential root-uptake metrics are structural invariants whose observed route differences are only binary64 arithmetic noise. This does not reclassify S3-C0 and does not authorize reduced dynamic feedback.

arithmetic_identity_contract.rationale: Fixed arithmetic identity criterion already used in independent prescribed-root qualification; it is not selected from the C0 route differences.
full_potential_identity: For every route/material/history/observation, actual_over_potential_fraction is arithmetic-identical to 1.
For every route/material/history/observation, interval_actual_root_uptake is arithmetic-identical to PTRA.
For every material/history/observation, each route is arithmetic-identical to R2048_T32 for interval uptake, fraction and cumulative uptake.

decision_rule.invariant_pass: All full-potential identity and route-to-target comparisons pass the fixed 64-epsilon criterion for all three quantities.

arithmetic_floor_if_pass.cumulative_actual_root_uptake_rmse_cm: 64*eps*max(1,max_abs_cumulative); because full-potential cumulative uptake remains <1 cm on the frozen horizon this is 64*eps

decision_rule.authority_implication_if_pass: May support a separate prospectively bound S3C0R requalification in which the two structural-invariant root metrics use the fixed arithmetic floor while the three hydraulic metrics retain their already qualified C0 Richardson uncertainties.
decision_rule.authority_implication_if_fail: C0 remains unqualified and Stage 3 dynamic response remains blocked.

prohibited: Do not alter or overwrite ROM_ROOT_S3C0_RESULT.json.
Do not generate U4/U8/R8/R16 dynamic-feedback response.
Do not derive a tolerance from observed D1 differences.
Do not change full-potential control physics, root distribution, Reference solver, numerical policy, routes or observations.
Do not treat this arithmetic identity bound as an application tolerance.
Do not authorize production or performance claims.
